package.limits: Focused optimized suite and package validation on the current host; not live UI, physical Intel/macOS14/26 or complete Photoshop equivalence evidence. Last full regression is step184, before this increment.

api.state: Persisted settings through Smart Filter state; workspace availability/open/busy and expanded capabilities/schema. Same native prepared transaction, source retention, busy/stale guards and Undo.

adobe_api.scope: No dedicated published operation. Unqualified blurGallery actionJSON and editable PSD/PSB descriptors reject explicitly; native gallery API remains distinct. Existing other Adobe jobs preserved.

limitations: Exact Photoshop pixels, effect composition, strobe exposure kernels, bokeh/noise distributions and live/physical-platform qualification remain open. Last desktop evidence locked; no re-probe or bypass.

Native Gaussian-level interpolation follows the Rust algorithm design. Enabled modes apply in field/iris/tiltShift/path/spin order; combined Photoshop behavior is unqualified. RGB8/16 encoded and RGB32 linear samples use existing filter paths.

Native filters are bounded to8,388,608 source pixels; gallery64 pins per tool,16 paths with2–32 nodes. Continuous motion64 samples; spin strobes up to30 flashes with1 or5 exposure samples. More demanding files need resource/performance expansion.

Path blur uses straight or Catmull–Rom control-point paths with speed/taper/centered controls. Exact Bezier/corner editing, per-endpoint speed, additional motion/strobe options for paths, high-quality settings and richer canvas interactions remain open.
Bokeh and uniform/Gaussian/grain controls are implemented; per-noise-type remembered presets and exact Photoshop models remain open.

Mask preview is a local intensity visualization; path mask uses maximum path speed and does not yet reproduce its full taper field. Exact mask display/hold-key behavior, ellipsoid display under all transforms and mixed geometry-filter input coordinates remain unqualified.
Editable PSD/PSB Blur Gallery descriptors are unsupported. Native29 preserves source/settings; rasterized/rendered exports work. Adobe actionJSON rejects rather than silently applying defaults.
Native Actions already record typed applyFilter values and retain Gallery settings; Adobe .atn/plugin interchange and exhaustive action compatibility remain separate gaps.
Offscreen layout/controller tests do not demonstrate real pointer/key interaction. F03 remains open until all scope, output and platform acceptance criteria are met.
next: F05 Lens Correction, followed by Adaptive Wide Angle and Vanishing Point: source audit, native controls/preview/history/persistence and API coverage. Continue major breadth before minor fidelity work.

development_audit.scope: Record/reference integrity only; not Photoshop parity.
